\u27e6CODE20\u27e7: ["```python", "from __future__ import annotations", "", "from collections.abc import Generator", "from contextlib import contextmanager", "from contextvars import ContextVar", "from typing import Any", "", "from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationInfo, field_validator", "", "_init_context_var = ContextVar('_init_context_var', default=None)", "", "", "@contextmanager", "def init_context(value: dict[str, Any]) -> Generator[None]:", "    token = _init_context_var.set(value)", "    try:", "        yield", "    finally:", "        _init_context_var.reset(token)", "", "", "class Model(BaseModel):", "    my_number: int", "", "    def __init__(self, /, **data: Any) -> None:", "        self.__pydantic_validator__.validate_python(", "            data,", "            self_instance=self,", "            context=_init_context_var.get(),", "        )", "", "    @field_validator('my_number')", "    @classmethod", "    def multiply_with_context(cls, value: int, info: ValidationInfo) -> int:", "        if isinstance(info.context, dict):", "            multiplier = info.context.get('multiplier', 1)", "            value = value * multiplier", "        return value", "", "", "print(Model(my_number=2))", "#> my_number=2", "", "with init_context({'multiplier': 3}):", "    print(Model(my_number=2))", "    #> my_number=6", "", "print(Model(my_number=2))", "#> my_number=2", "```"]
